replacement.old:
FROM public.accounting_payable_earning_sources s WHERE s.club_id=period.club_id AND s.coordinator_union_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM period.union_id
  AND s.earned_at>=period.start_at AND s.earned_at<period.end_at;
replacement.new:
FROM (
  SELECT * FROM public.accounting_payable_earning_sources a
   WHERE period.union_id IS NULL AND a.coordinator_union_id IS NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM public.accounting_payable_earning_sources a
   WHERE period.union_id IS NOT NULL AND a.coordinator_union_id=period.union_id
 )s WHERE s.club_id=period.club_id
  AND s.earned_at>=period.start_at AND s.earned_at<period.end_at;
